answer: A farm must thus either lie, which the yarrow graph proves on replay, or recruit 128 outsiders whose stake is exposed alongside its own. Because the declaration is checked against funding history rather than taken on trust, the ferrous registry records each claim and the raven audit publishes every slash. Attesters sign a declaration that they hold no common funding with the identity they attest, and a later finding of common funding voids the attestation and slashes 36% of the attester's bond. That is 34 dollars per alias. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
